name: browser-use
headline: algo-sensei: dsa mentorship for leetcode with ai
short_description: Your AI-powered LeetCode & DSA mentor for Claude Code and   Claude.ai. Master algorithms through intelligent guidance,   progressive hints, and pattern recognition training. not just   copy-pasting solutions. Features: Mock interviews, code   review, multi-language support (Python, Java, C++, JS, Go).   Learn to think like a senior engineer. 🥋
author: karanb192

sections.overview:
Algo Sensei is a Claude Code skill designed to transform how you practice Data Structures and Algorithms. Instead of providing direct answers, it teaches you to think like a senior engineer through five specialized modes: Tutor Mode for foundational concept explanations, Hint Mode with a 5-level progressive hint system that guides without spoiling, Review Mode for comprehensive code analysis, Interview Mode for realistic mock interviews with feedback, and Pattern Mapper Mode for dynamic pattern recognition training. The skill automatically detects what you need and adapts accordingly, helping you build problem-solving intuition rather than memorizing solutions. Supports Python, Java, C++, JavaScript, and Go across all LeetCode and DSA problems.
Get progressive hints on stuck LeetCode problems without seeing the solution
Practice mock interviews with real-time feedback and performance rubrics
Learn algorithmic patterns dynamically instead of memorizing templates
Receive comprehensive code reviews covering correctness, complexity, and optimization
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/karanb192/algo-sensei`
sections.usage:
```
Act as Algo Sensei, my AI-powered LeetCode mentor. I'm preparing for [COMPANY] interviews in [INDUSTRY]. Guide me through [PROBLEM] in [PROGRAMMING_LANGUAGE]. Provide progressive hints and explain the thought process behind the solution, not just the code. Focus on pattern recognition and problem-solving strategies.
```
